title: Harmonizing Safety and Speed: A Human-Algorithm Approach to Enhance the FDA's Medical Device Clearance Policy
abstract: arXiv:2407.11823v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The United States Food and Drug Administration's (FDA's) 510(k) pathway allows manufacturers to gain medical device approval by demonstrating substantial equivalence to a legally marketed device. However, the inherent ambiguity of this regulatory procedure has been associated with high recall among many devices cleared through this pathway, raising significant safety concerns. In this paper, we develop a combined human-algorithm approach to assist the FDA in improving its 510(k) medical device clearance process by reducing recall risk and regulatory workload. We first develop machine learning methods to estimate the risk of recall of 510(k) medical devices based on the information available at the time of submission. We then propose a data-driven clearance policy that recommends acceptance, rejection, or deferral to FDA's committees for in-depth evaluation. translated_title: 协调安全与速度：一种人机协同方法优化FDA医疗器械审批政策
translated_abstract: 美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）的510(k)途径允许制造商通过证明其产品与已合法上市器械的实质等同性来获得医疗器械批准。然而，这一监管程序固有的模糊性与通过该途径批准的许多器械的高召回率相关，引发了重大的安全隐患。在本文中，我们开发了一种结合人类与算法的方法，以帮助FDA改进其510(k)医疗器械审批流程，从而降低召回风险和监管工作量。我们首先基于提交时的可用信息，开发机器学习方法来估计510(k)医疗器械的召回风险。然后，我们提出一种数据驱动的审批政策，建议接受、拒绝或将器械转交FDA委员会进行深入评估。我们使用包含超过31,000份提交的独特数据集进行了实证研究。
tldr: 本文提出了一种人机协同方法，利用机器学习预测510(k)器械召回风险，并设计数据驱动的审批政策，以在提升FDA审批效率的同时降低安全风险。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a human-algorithm approach that uses machine learning to predict recall risk of 510(k) devices and designs a data-driven clearance policy to enhance FDA review efficiency while reducing safety risks.
